visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a shot of a woman with long black hair, viewed from the back, wearing a yellow knitted cardigan and carrying a black bag. She is walking through a doorway into an indoor space. Pink heart-shaped graphics float across the screen. (2) The scene cuts to the woman now facing the camera, smiling and gesturing with her hands. She is wearing a white crop top under a light beige cardigan and blue denim jeans. The background shows an office or storage area with several brown cardboard boxes stacked against a wall. (3) The woman is shown in a closer shot, speaking energetically. She stands in a living room area with a large television and audio equipment visible behind her. Bright, energetic star-shaped and flame graphics appear around her to emphasize her points. (4) A screen capture of a computer monitor displays a list of orders on a website interface. The woman's face appears in a small circular inset at the bottom left, continuing her explanation. (5) Back to the woman in a bright room with light-colored curtains. She holds a white paper and points toward the camera, her expressions are lively and exaggerated. (6) A series of graphic slides appear, detailing promotional offers. They feature images of the brand's products (red boxes), an iPhone, an Apple Watch, and flight tickets. A cartoon rabbit graphic is also present. (7) Final scene returns to the woman in the box-filled storage area. She waves goodbye to the camera while holding papers. The lighting is bright and even throughout the video.

(2) A transition sound effect 'whoosh' triggers a shift to a conversational dialogue between the female and an off-screen male voice. The female voice remains high-arousal and cheerful. (3) A sharp 'ding' sound accompanies the appearance of star graphics. The female speaker increases her speech intensity as she explains the high order volume. (4) A digital clicking sound is heard as the screen capture phase begins. The music maintains a constant bright tempo in the background. (5) A 'ta-da' style chime plays when promotional graphics appear. The woman's voice becomes more narrative and persuasive, detailing prices and percentages. (6) A final 'ping' sound marks the call to action, followed by a quick fade-out of the music as the woman says goodbye.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Conflict -> Proof -> Offer -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for 'Hsinyen Biotech' (昕顏生技). It uses a humorous 'behind-the-scenes' hook about the boss working during holidays to showcase the high volume of orders, thereby establishing product popularity. It then transitions into a clear listing of Mid-Autumn and Double Ten festival promotional discounts and a lucky draw (iPhone, flights) to incentivize immediate purchases.
